glosses: The ordinal form of the number thirty-six, describing a person or thing in position number 36 of a sequence.

examples.text: The answer appears on the thirty-sixth page of the book.
She finished thirty-sixth in the race.

glosses: One of thirty-six equal parts of a whole.
